t016_increment.commit_scope: implementation_core_commit identifies the first core snapshot only. Later code, test, gate and build revisions have their own evidence. Resolve final tested source and outcome from the progress report and matching latest actual reports.
t016_increment.current_strict_gate_status: This directory does not assert the final result. Consult the progress report and its latest actual gate reports; a previous PASS, a report file existing, or a repair without rerun is insufficient for current source.

confirmed_feature_evidence.scope: 57 isolated business tests before lock-order correction
confirmed_feature_evidence.meaning: Real SQL role/object facts and six-role conditional authority with explicit synthetic institutional inputs; not all six roles allowed and not formal adoption.
confirmed_feature_evidence.historical_quality_failure_not_erased: The completed 57-test snapshot still had a quality failure; later isolated lint/format/mypy proof is recorded separately in the progress report.

t016_increment.new_operation_four_class_denial_gate: The 43-operation401/403/missing-policy503/dependency-failure503 and pre-side-effect assertions remain required. Their current outcome is read from the latest actual T014 report matching final tested source.
remaining: Resolve final clean T014/T015/T016 reports, applicable revocation cases, hosted CI and source synchronization from exact-source actual receipts; historical successes and repaired failures stay separately recorded.
Real confirmation/execution actor and role-separation policy; independently authorized consumer integration.
Formal token TTL, independent HMAC key custody/adoption and operational effect of the current <=5-second fact deadline.
Real seal/report/delete/unseal/model consumers; AuditExport public contract separately reviewed.
Shared migration, backup/recovery/adoption and whole-source-task acceptance.
t016_increment.pass_record_flags_scope: False means no final PASS is asserted in this directory; it does not override a later actual report. Final gate and hosted CI outcomes must be checked against exact tested source and hashes.

final_conclusion_authority.selection_rule: Follow actual report references published by the progress record, verify report status, exact tested commit and source hashes, and keep historical snapshots distinct. Do not interpret a planned or missing report reference as completed evidence.
final_conclusion_authority.runtime_gates: T014, T015 and T016 are separate retained gates; all applicable gates need actual results for the final tested source.
final_conclusion_authority.CI_and_source_sync: Hosted CI must match its own exact commit/run. GitHub/Linux source synchronization and database/service adoption are separate outcomes.

historical_four_case_watchlist.meaning: A previous document state tracked these cases as awaiting a new receipt. This preserves that prior watchlist, not their current execution status.

t016_increment.current_revocation_results: Approval/source/person/result and synthetic duty revocation combinations: resolve their actual applicable nodeids and results from the latest matching report. Test presence and historical watchlists are not current PASS or permanent pending decisions.

source_authorization_snapshot_scope.binding: task.asset_id -> media_asset.source_id within the same authorized org/case
source_authorization_snapshot_scope.coverage_boundary: Current single-asset task source only; no multi-input source closure claimed.
source_authorization_snapshot_scope.runtime_verdict: See latest matching actual report; implementation scope is not a standalone PASS.

t016_increment.synthetic_duty_revocation_scope: Synthetic institutional duty/revocation combinations only; formal cross-person delegation and real consumer actor authority are not adopted.
